# proofback

> proofback brings reviewer feedback on a compiled LaTeX PDF (highlights, strike-outs, carets, sticky notes; later email notes and Word tracked changes) back to the exact file, line and character range of the LaTeX source, tracks each item's status and replies across drafts in `.proofback/` inside the author's repo, and exports patches, an answered PDF and a response letter. Deterministic, offline core in Rust (native + WebAssembly); AI agents use it through an MCP server. Status: in design, nothing released yet.

## Docs
- [Project plan](https://github.com/Amet13/proofback/blob/main/docs/PLAN.md): scope, architecture, data model, matching pipeline, roadmap, decision log
- [README](https://github.com/Amet13/proofback/blob/main/README.md)

## Planned interfaces
- CLI: `proofback import|list|show|resolve|patch|apply|sync|answer|letter|mcp`, `--json` on every command
- MCP tools: list_items, get_item, propose_patch, apply_patch, resolve_item, sync, export

## Related
- [overfull](https://github.com/Amet13/overfull): pre-submission checks for LaTeX papers (a different tool; proofback starts after review)
